unscii is by Viznut (http://viznut.fi/unscii/).

The download has no licence file. The author's page (http://viznut.fi/unscii/) says: "unscii-16-full" falls

variants are copied here (`unscii-16.hex`, `unscii-8-mcr.hex`, `unscii-8-fantasy.hex`, `unscii-8-tall.hex`, the
